1) the resistivity of the alluvial aquifer is inversely correlated with water content; 2) the resistivity increases in response to recharge and decreases in response to drought; 3) the resistivity is higher in the alluvial fan than in the alluvium of the Rio Grande valley; 4) the resistivity decreases with depth in the alluvia; and 5) the resistivity varies with depth in the bedrock.
